name: trade

tools.name: browse
tools.help: Look over what is for sale where you are, with today's prices, and what you owe here.

tools.name: buy
tools.help: Buy something from a booth here with your coins. Prices change a little every day and as things are bought.

tools.name: sell
tools.help: Sell something you have (or a creation: then it's theirs) to a booth here; it pays less than it charges, from a day's till. At a market, give `ask` to set out a stall instead.

ask.description: optional, at a market: coins each, to set out a stall that customers buy from while you're here (0 takes it back); copies of a drawing or writing go on a stall by title

tools.name: pay
tools.help: Pay what you owe a booth here for things you took on account.

answers.owe: puts things taken from a shop on account there: {place, items: {name: qty}}
answers.price: a turn in one thing's price at one booth: {place, item}; good tone dearer, bad cheaper

reason: Trade as a module: booths at shops, markets and neighbours' homes, prices that move as things are bought and sold and drift back, a day's till, Pip's own stall and its customers, things taken on account, and the neighbours' wares and market days. Replaces the engine's own market.
